digest.component_or_area: CLI verb hierarchy / bridge command group
propositions: Three CLI verbs are being renamed to nest under a unified 'bridge' noun: bridge-fsck → bridge fsck, bridge-probe → bridge check-access, jira-onboard → bridge setup, with old spellings preserved as compatibility entrypoints
The schema file bridge_fsck.schema.json must have both its $id and description fields updated to reflect the new verb name 'bridge fsck'

Every enumerated in-tree consumer including CLI help files, tests, scripts, workflows, and documentation must migrate to the new canonical spellings while allowing legacy spellings to remain functional
The bridge setup subcommand must pass through to the unchanged jira_onboard wizard via argparse REMAINDER, preserving all options and injecting environment overlays for validation step

Behavioral parity tests must verify both old and new spellings produce identical output, exit codes, and state effects, with check-access remaining a standalone verb rather than a flag due to its destructive Jira operations
